TCD.note: Licensing is by the regional banking commission Cobac, not stated as the central bank.
Only fund-protection duties on a licensee; no consumer rule or complaints body.

facts.fact: The article says the Cobac regulation of 21 December 2018 replaced the 2011 e-money framework and created the payment institution status for CEMAC states including Chad.

Moov Money Tchad SA obtained payment institution approval in the first half of 2026, joining Airtel Money (March 2022) and Konoom (October 2025), per Maroc Telecom's half-year report cited by Ecomatin.

TCD.note: Only active account counts (6.25 million), not a share of adults.

facts.fact: Moov Money Tchad launched in January 2021 and the article says Chad had 6.25 million active mobile money accounts at end-2024 per the BEAC report, with 180.2 million transactions in the year.

TCD.note: A plan to drop the transfer tax is not electronic revenue payment.
